cases.given: The writer needs decisions and source pointers but not the worker's full context.
cases.expect: The writer receives traceable state or the workflow reports a handoff failure.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: all work occurs inside one uninterrupted component
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Host, system, domain, and explicit user authority take precedence over this component.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: no real host-supported handoff channel exists
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: explicit payload, provenance, receiver boundary, and delivery status

cases.given: separate modules need to transfer task state across a real boundary
cases.expect: a typed provenance-bearing envelope is validated, transmitted, and acknowledged
cases.reject: claiming hidden shared memory or passing an unbounded context dump
